summary.en: Get permission to build or renovate a building. The city checks your land ownership, your drawings against zoning and safety rules, then issues a permit you must display on site. Required before any foundation work.
summary.am: ህንፃ ለመገንባት ወይም ለማደስ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ያግኙ። ከተማው የመሬት ባለቤትነትዎንና ስዕሎችዎን ይመረምራል፣ ከዚያም ፈቃድ ይሰጣል።

title.en: Confirm your land ownership / leasehold title

description.en: You can only build on land you legally own or hold under leasehold. Collect your title deed or leasehold agreement, confirm the plot number and that no encumbrance (mortgage, dispute, government expropriation notice) blocks construction.
description.am: በህጋዊ መንገድ በባለቤትነት ወይም በኪራይ ይዞታ ባለዎት መሬት ላይ ብቻ መገንባት ይችላሉ።

responsible_office.am: የከተማ / የክፍለ ከተማ የመሬት አስተዳደር ጽህፈት ቤት

official_timeline.en: 1–3 working days (verification visit may be scheduled)

label.en: Title deed or leasehold agreement (original + copy)
label.am: የባለቤትነት ወረቀት ወይም የኪራይ ውል (መጀመሪያ + ቅጂ)

label.en: Property tax clearance for the plot (if held long-term)

title.en: Hire a licensed architect and engineer

description.en: The city only accepts drawings signed and stamped by professionals licensed in Ethiopia. You need an architect for the architectural drawings and a structural engineer for the structural design. Keep their licenses and certificates — you must submit copies with the application.
description.am: ከተማው በኢትዮጵያ ፈቃድ ያላቸው ባለሙያዎች የተፈረሙና የታሸጉ ስዕሎችን ብቻ ይቀበላል።

description.en: Your architect prepares the site plan, floor plans, elevations and sections; the engineer prepares the structural design. The drawings must match the plot and comply with the local building code, zoning rules (setbacks, height limits, floor-area ratio) and, in Addis, the Oromia Special Zone / city master plan requirements.
description.am: አርክቴክትዎ የቦታ እቅድ፣ የወለል እቅዶችና ንድፎችን ያዘጋጃል፤ መሀንዲሱ ደግሞ የመዋቅር ንድፍ ያዘጋጃል።

description.en: Submit the application form with all drawings and documents at the city construction permit office. Pay the application fee, get a receipt and a file/reference number. Missing or inconsistent documents are the most common reason the file is returned unread.
description.am: የማመልከቻ ቅጹን ከሁሉም ስዕሎችና ሰነዶች ጋር በከተማው የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ያቅርቡ።

responsible_office.en: City construction permit office (sub-city branch in Addis Ababa)

label.en: Full drawing set (site plan + architectural + structural)

title.en: Technical review by the permit committee

description.en: Engineers at the permit office review the drawings against the building code and zoning rules. You may be called in to answer questions or asked to revise drawings. Revisions are common — budget for at least one round.
description.am: በፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤቱ መሀንዲሶች ስዕሎቹን ከህንፃ ኮድና የዞን ህጎች ጋር ይመረምራሉ።

responsible_office.en: City construction permit office — technical review team
responsible_office.am: የከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት — የቴክኒክ ግምገማ ቡድን

title.en: Pay the permit fee and collect your permit

description.en: Once approved, pay the building permit fee (scaled by floor area and use) at the designated bank/cashier, then return with the receipt to collect the permit. Display the permit at the construction site before starting work — inspectors check for it.
description.am: ከጸደቀ በኋላ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ክፍያውን ይክፈሉ፣ ከዚያም በደረሰኝ ተመልሰው ፈቃድዎን ይቀበሉ።

responsible_office.en: City construction permit office — issuance desk
responsible_office.am: የከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት — የመስጫ ዴስክ

common_rejection_reasons.en: Land ownership / leasehold not verified or under dispute
common_rejection_reasons.am: የመሬት ባለቤትነት አልተረጋገጠም ወይም በክርክር ላይ ነው

common_rejection_reasons.en: Drawings not signed/stamped by a licensed professional
Zoning violations: setback, height limit, or floor-area ratio exceeded
common_rejection_reasons.am: የዞን ህግ ጥሰት: ከፍታ ገደብ ወይም የቦታ ምጥጥን ተላልፏል

common_rejection_reasons.en: Drawings do not match the plot size or shape
Incomplete file: missing forms, receipts, or document copies
Building use not permitted in that zone (e.g. commercial in residential-only area)

notes.en: Addis Ababa sub-city construction permit offices handle applications up to a size threshold; larger projects go to the central Addis Ababa City Administration permit office. Setbacks and height rules follow the city master plan — check your plot's zone before drafting.
notes.am: የአዲስ አበባ ክፍለ ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤቶች ማመልከቻዎችን ይቀበላሉ፤ ትላልቅ ፕሮጀክቶች ወደ ማዕከላዊ ጽህፈት ቤት ይሄዳሉ።

notes.en: Handled by the Amhara Region / Bahir Dar City construction permit office. Rural-urban land administration differs — confirm your plot's status (urban vs. peri-urban) first.
notes.am: በባህር ዳር ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

responsible_office.en: Bahir Dar City land administration office
Bahir Dar City construction permit office
Bahir Dar City construction permit office

notes.en: Handled by the Sidama Region / Hawassa City construction permit office. Same federal building code applies; local zoning rules differ.
notes.am: በሲዳማ ክልል / አዋሳ ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

notes.en: Handled by the Tigray Region / Mekelle City construction permit office. Land title checks may take longer — confirm your plot's status before drafting.
notes.am: በትግራይ ክልል / መቀሌ ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

notes.en: Handled by the Oromia Region / Jimma City construction permit office. Zoning follows the city's structure plan — check your plot's zone before drafting.
notes.am: በኦሮሚያ ክልል / ጅማ ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

notes.en: Handled by the Amhara Region / Gondar City construction permit office. Historic-city heritage rules may add review steps for properties near protected sites.
notes.am: በአማራ ክልል / ጎንደር ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

notes.en: Handled by the Oromia Region / Adama City construction permit office. High growth means permit volumes are large — expect longer technical review queues.
notes.am: በኦሮሚያ ክልል / አዳማ ከተማ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።
